rules.description: Rule is triggered when an Accounting Case is created/edited and the Status is 'Unassigned' and the owner is 'Accounting'
Whenever a Case record is created with the Case Origin equal to 'Email - Accounting', the workflow will fire to update the record type to 'Accounting'

rules.fullName: Case Origin is Email - Portfolio Management
rules.description: Whenever a Case record is created with the Case Origin equal to 'Email - Portfolio Management', the workflow will fire to update the record type to 'Portfolio Management'.
When the Case Subject Contains ACH, the case type will be updated to 'ACH'
rules.formula: ( CONTAINS(Subject, " ACH")|| CONTAINS(Subject, "ACH ")|| CONTAINS(Subject, "-ACH")|| CONTAINS(Subject, "ACH:")|| CONTAINS(Subject, "ach:")|| CONTAINS(Subject, " ach")|| CONTAINS(Subject, "ach ")|| CONTAINS(Subject, "-ach") ) && NOT(CONTAINS(Subject, "Debit")) && RecordType.Name = 'Accounting' && NOT(CONTAINS(Subject, "mod"))

rules.description: When the Case Subject Contains ACH Debit, the case type will be updated to 'ACH Debit'

When the Case Subject Contains Check Request, the case type will be updated to 'Check Request'

When the Case Subject Contains Mod, the case type will be updated to 'Loan Modification'
rules.formula: AND( RecordType.Name="Accounting", OR( CONTAINS( Subject,"MOD "), CONTAINS( Subject," MOD")) )
